title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
The successful candidate will communicate with suppliers, freight forwarders and other logistics partners, ensuring that every shipment has the correct documentation and that all shipment information is accurately recorded in our internal systems.



This role requires strong written English, attention to detail, good computer skills and previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain or import/export operations.



Main Responsibilities

Draft and send professional
s to suppliers, freight forwarders and logistics partners.

Follow up with suppliers and forwarders regarding collections, shipping arrangements and delivery progress.

Ensure that all required shipping and customs documents are received and complete.

Check documents such as commercial invoices, packing lists, transport documents and customs paperwork.

Keep shipment information accurate and up to date within the company’s internal system.

Record important shipment details, including collection dates, delivery dates, tracking information, costs and documentation.

Monitor shipments and follow up on any delays, missing information or outstanding documents.

Check invoices received from freight forwarders and other logistics vendors.

Match each logistics invoice to the correct shipment and verify that the charges are accurate.

Prepare and allocate logistics invoices correctly for recording in QuickBooks.

Maintain organised digital records for every shipment.

Report discrepancies, additional charges or shipment issues to management.

Assist with general logistics administration and reporting when required.

Requirements

Previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, import/export or a similar role.

Good understanding of international shipping processes and documentation.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong
-writing and professional communication skills.

Very good computer skills and confidence using online systems.

Experience with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and cloud-based systems.

Experience with QuickBooks is preferred.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to organise and manage multiple shipments and tasks at the same time.

Comfortable following up with suppliers and logistics partners.

Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-working environment.

Availability to work during UK business hours.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is organised, proactive and comfortable taking responsibility for following shipments from collection through to delivery. They should be able to identify missing information, follow up without being reminded and ensure that all records and costs are correctly updated.

title: CapCut + Higgsfield Editor for Daily Solo Reality Show
description:
I’m looking for a creative editor to help me produce one daily 45–60 second vertical episode for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Please watch these two references first:









My project is a creative solo version of this polished reality-show style.



I will film a confessional plus simple daily footage of getting ready, doing my hair and makeup, opening product samples, working on my beauty brands, messaging suppliers, drinking tea, visiting coffee shops, and going to ballet.



The confessional audio will carry most of the story, but my face should only appear for part of the finished video. My voice should continue underneath B-roll so the episode feels like television rather than a talking-head Reel.



The editor will use:



Real-life B-roll that supports what I am saying

Establishing shots that introduce each location or brand world

Music, titles, character cards, and sound design

J-cuts and L-cuts so the audio flows smoothly between scenes

Close-ups of products, hands, tea, clothing, packaging, and beauty rituals

Reaction shots and a funny or unresolved ending



You will also use my Higgsfield account to create occasional AI scenes, such as:



My AI twin walking through a beautiful city or fashion setting

Recurring fantasy rooms for my hair, lash, and nail brands

Cinematic city or location transitions

Short fantasy hero shots that elevate the real footage



The AI footage should be used sparingly. The real confessional and real-life footage remain the heart of the episode.



You should be comfortable with CapCut, Higgsfield, music selection, storytelling, and posting approved videos across social platforms.



Pay: $56 per week for one daily video using a repeatable format. There will be a paid test edit.



To apply, begin with SOLO REALITY SHOW and send:



Your three best edits

Any AI image or video examples

Confirmation that you watched both references

A short explanation of how you would use my confessional audio, B-roll, establishing shots, and one AI fantasy scene to create a polished episode

title: Assistant E-commerce Manager (Shopify & CRO Specialist)
description:
About Us:

Pop On Veneers is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) smile brands in the United States. We help thousands of customers smile with confidence through custom-made cosmetic veneers and innovative oral care products. We move fast, rely heavily on data, and love scaling great ideas.



The Role:

We are looking for an execution-focused, highly analytical Assistant E-commerce Manager to optimize, maintain, and scale our digital storefront. This is NOT an entry-level position. We require deep, hands-on technical experience managing a complex Shopify ecosystem. You will work closely with our E-commerce Manager to turn traffic into revenue, protect site health, and maximize customer lifetime value.



What You'll Do:

- Store Optimization & Landing Pages: Build, launch, and update conversion-focused product and landing pages inside Shopify, ensuring a seamless user experience.

- Subscription & Offer Architecture: Own the technical setup of Recharge and Rebuy. Configure post-purchase offers, smart cross-sells, and automated subscription flows to lift AOV and retention.

- Retention Marketing Execution: Build, segment, and QA automated flows and revenue-driving campaigns within Klaviyo, keeping a close eye on deliverability and performance metrics.

- A/B Testing & Pricing Strategy: Run price elasticity and layout experiments using Intelligems to mathematically prove what drives higher margins.

- Site Health & QA: Act as our first line of defense. Audit the store daily for broken discounts, app conflicts, or checkout bugs, resolving them before they impact sales.

- Data Reporting: Track and report weekly on key metrics: Conversion Rate (CR), Average Order Value (AOV), Churn, and
 Revenue.



What We Are Looking For:

- 3+ Years of Direct Shopify Experience: Deep, daily management of Shopify, Klaviyo, Recharge, Rebuy, and Intelligems is non-negotiable. You must understand how these apps interact.

- Direct-Response Marketing Mindset: You understand consumer psychology, what makes a high-converting landing page hook, and how to position offers to drive immediate action.

- Data over Guesswork: You enjoy digging into dashboards, identifying where users are dropping off in the funnel, and suggesting data-backed solutions.

- Ruthless Attention to Detail: You catch typos, broken links, and faulty coupon codes instantly.



Perks & Benefits:

- Competitive salary ($1,500 - $1,800+/month) with room for growth.

- Paid Time Off

- Stable, long-term career with a thriving US brand.



To apply for the position please use the following link: popon.forms.app/appforemployment

description:
WHO ARE WE

We're a weight loss company that publishes educational long-form videos on YouTube.

. Your job is to bring those storyboards to life through animation.



You will NOT be asked to make creative decisions about storytelling, pacing, or structure. Those are already handled. What we need is someone who can take a clear plan and execute it reliably, on time, at a consistent quality bar.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Animate 10–15 minute video storyboards created by our editors in Canva

- Build motion graphics: text animations, transitions, object movement, simple infographic animation, lower thirds

- Work directly with our video editors through Slack and 

- Deliver first cuts on schedule and turn around revision rounds quickly

- Build and maintain a library of reusable animation templates so our output gets faster over time

- Flag questions early when a storyboard instruction is unclear — we'd much rather answer a question on day one than get a wrong cut on day four



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll report to our video editors and communicate with them daily via Slack. They will hand you storyboards and review your cuts in 
. They present the finished work to our founder in Monday–Thursday syncs. You're welcome (not required) to sit in on a few of these early on to see how we think about editing.



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years of motion graphics / animation experience

- Strong proficiency in After Effects (required). Premiere Pro a plus.

- Comfortable working from Canva storyboards or similar visual briefs

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle After Effects without constant crashes

- Written English strong enough to ask clear questions and explain where you're stuck

- Available for consistent full-time work — this is your main job, not a side project



Nice to have

- Experience animating for YouTube specifically (you understand retention-focused editing)

- Experience with 

- Ability to create simple custom illustrations or icons when the storyboard calls for something not in the asset library



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST

Reliability over flash. We would rather have someone who hits every deadline with solid, clean animation than someone with a stunning reel who disappears for three days.



Communication. If you're stuck, confused, or running late — tell us immediately. We will never penalize you for raising a problem early. We will lose confidence fast if problems surface only at the deadline.



Consistency. Our videos should look like they came from the same studio every week.



HOW TO APPLY

I'll pay you to animate 1 minute of a storyboard:

  - Pages 2-23 of this storyboard: 

  - A-roll - you'll need to cut the intro and start where Section 1 storyboard starts

  - Graphic assets: 



Reply with the word "STORYBOARD", your rate for this work, your portfolio, and any questions. Then if I give you the green light, you can proceed to animate 1 minute of the storyboard.

Run the LinkedIn outreach campaign daily in Sales Navigator + Waalaxy: build and refine target lists, launch and monitor sequences per our playbook, and keep the pipeline moving

Respond to every inbound reply across two channels 
 dashboard + LinkedIn) within the response-time SLA

Record every process you run as a video SOP in Scribe



Read carefully, because how you apply is part of the evaluation. Start your application with the word MAGELLAN and tell me the last CRM you kept clean.

Strong English judgment — our system generates the response drafts; you need to recognize when a draft is right, when it's off for the conversation, and how to fix it. You'll also handle quick live replies on LinkedIn yourself.

Real CRM experience — you have kept a pipeline accurate before and can describe exactly how

Available ~20 hours/week with daily coverage overlapping 6am–10 am US Eastern

Stable internet and backup power



To apply, answer these three questions. Short, specific answers beat long ones.



1. Here is a reply we received: "Thanks for reaching out. I run a 12-agent shop in Tampa, been thinking about AI but honestly don't know where to start. What is this exactly?" What day works?" Would you send this as-is? If not, what would you change and why?

• Document verification results clearly in the electronic health record or designated tracking system.

• Communicate benefit estimates and coverage concerns to the practice owner.

• Follow up when eligibility or benefit information is incomplete or inconsistent.



Claims Submission and Rejection Management

• Review claims for completeness before submission.

• Confirmation of patient demographics, payer information, provider identifiers, modifiers, and place-of-service information are accurate.

• Submit or monitor electronic claims through the practice’s EHR and clearinghouse.

• Review clearinghouse rejections and correct routine submission errors.

• Distinguish clearinghouse rejections from payer denials.

• Track claims from initial submission through payment or final resolution.

• Submit corrected claims when authorized.

• Identify claims approaching timely-filing deadlines.



Denials and Accounts-Receivable Follow-Up

• Review explanations of benefits, electronic remittance advice, rejection reports, and payer correspondence.

• Investigate unpaid, underpaid, rejected, or denied claims.

• Contact insurance companies to obtain claim status and denial information.

• Document payer reference numbers, representative names, call dates, and required next steps.

• Prepare routine reconsiderations and appeals using practice-approved templates.

• Escalate coding, contractual, credentialing, or medical-necessity issues to the practice owner.

• Maintain an organized denial and accounts-receivable worklist.

• Follow claims through resolution rather than documenting a single contact attempt.

• Identify recurring denial patterns and recommend workflow improvements.



Payment Posting and Reconciliation 

Depending on experience and assigned scope:

• Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and patient responsibility.

• Review electronic remittance reports for accuracy.

• Identify discrepancies between expected and received reimbursement.

• Track payer recoupments, take-backs, refunds, and unapplied payments.

• Assist with reconciliation between claims, remittances, and deposits.

• Notify the practice owner before processing unusual adjustments, refunds, or write-offs.



Provider Credentialing

• Maintain a credentialing checklist for each new provider.

• Collect and organize required provider information and supporting documents.

• Review applications for completeness before submission.

• Assist with individual and group enrollment applications.

• Track applications from initiation through approval and effective date.

• Follow up with insurance companies, credentialing organizations, and enrollment departments.

• Document submission dates, reference numbers, outstanding items, and payer responses.

• Notify the practice owner promptly of delays, discrepancies, or requests for additional information.

• Maintain copies of submitted applications, approval letters, contracts, and payer correspondence.

• Confirm that approved providers are correctly linked to the practice’s group, billing entity, service locations, and tax identification number.

• Verify that payer systems reflect the correct rendering, billing, pay-to, and service-location information.

• Assist with electronic claims, ERA, EFT, and clearinghouse enrollment after credentialing approval.

• Track recredentialing deadlines and recurring attestation requirements.

• Maintain an up-to-date credentialing roster showing each provider’s status with each payer.

• NB: This role is secondary to primary billing responsibilities. 



Intake and Administrative Support 

As workload permits:

• Review new-patient intake information for completeness.

• Confirm that required demographic and insurance information has been submitted.

• Request missing insurance cards, identification, referral information, or intake documents.

• Assist with routine patient communication regarding insurance information and administrative requirements.

• Maintain professional and courteous communication with patients, payers, and referral sources.



Limits of Authority 

The specialist will not independently:

• Select or change CPT, ICD-10, or modifier coding without approval.

• Alter clinical documentation.

• Make medical-necessity determinations.

• Approve refunds, write-offs, or unusual account adjustments.

• Negotiate payer contracts.

• Change provider enrollment or credentialing information without authorization.

• Access practice banking accounts.

• Represent themselves as a licensed clinician.

• Disclose protected health information outside authorized systems or workflows.



All coding changes, substantive appeals, refunds, write-offs, and unusual payer issues must be reviewed by the practice owner.



Required Qualifications

• At least two years of experience with U.S. medical billing, insurance verification, claims follow-up, or revenue-cycle management.

• Direct experience working with commercial health-insurance plans.

• Ability to interpret EOBs, ERAs, claim-status reports, rejection notices, and denial codes.

• Experience contacting payers and documenting claim follow-up.

• Understanding of deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, contractual adjustments, and patient responsibility.

• Familiarity with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Reliable internet access and a private, secure workspace.

• Excellent organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and provide concise updates.

• Willingness to use practice-approved communication, password-management, and document-storage systems.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with outpatient behavioral-health or psychiatric billing.

• Familiarity with CPT codes such as 90792, 99205, 99213–99215,
, 99417.

• Experience with psychotherapy add-on codes.

• Experience with Maryland Medicaid, Carelon Behavioral Health, Availity, CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield, Aetna, Cigna,/Evernorth and UnitedHealthcare/Optum.

• Familiarity with Office Ally or a comparable healthcare clearinghouse.

• Experience working with both Type 1 and Type 2 NPIs.

• Experience identifying payer enrollment, credentialing, and electronic-claims setup problems.

• Experience with corrected claims, reconsiderations, formal appeals, and timely-filing disputes.

• Experience with patient-balance follow-up and payment posting.

• Certification or formal training in medical billing or coding is helpful but not required.



Technology and Security Requirements 

The selected candidate must:

• Sign a Business Associate Agreement and confidentiality agreement when applicable.

• Complete or provide documentation of current HIPAA training.

• Use a personal, password-protected computer with current antivirus, security updates, AND VPN.

• Use multifactor authentication whenever available.

• Work from a private location where patient information cannot be seen or overheard.

• Avoid downloading, printing, photographing, or locally storing patient information unless specifically authorized.

• Use only practice-approved systems for patient and claim information.

• Immediately report suspected privacy, security, or account-access i
.

• Return or permanently delete practice information at the end of the engagement, as directed.



Initial Priorities

During the first 60–90 days, the specialist will focus on:

1. Learning the practice’s payer mix, EHR, clearinghouse, and claims workflow.

2. Verifying insurance benefits for upcoming patients.

3. Reviewing unresolved clearinghouse rejections.

4. Following up on unpaid claims and documenting next steps.

5. Identifying claims approaching timely-filing limits.

6. Preparing a weekly summary of unresolved claims, denials, and recommended actions.

7. Identifying repeated errors or workflow gaps that may be delaying payment.

The role may expand as the practice and claim volume grow.



Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

• Accuracy and completeness of insurance verification.

• Timeliness of claim submission and follow-up.

• Reduction in unresolved clearinghouse rejections.

• Appropriate and timely management of denied claims.

• Quality of documentation.

• Accuracy of payment posting, if assigned.

• Consistency in following claims through resolution.

• Responsiveness and professional communication.

• Protection of patient information.

• Ability to identify problems before they result in lost revenue.

• Reliability in completing assigned work without repeated reminders.



Reporting Expectations

The specialist will provide a brief daily and end of week reports that includes:

• Claims submitted.

• Claims rejected and corrected.

• Claims denied and the reasons for denial.

• Claims awaiting payer action.

• Claims approaching timely-filing deadlines.

• Payments or underpayments requiring review.

• Patient or insurance information still needed.

• Issues requiring the practice owner’s decision.

• Total hours worked and major tasks completed.



A monthly summary may also include aging accounts receivable, denial trends, collection activity, and recommended process changes.



Working Relationship

The specialist will report directly to and maintain a close, positive and collaborative relationship with the practice owner. Communication will generally occur through phone calls, secure messaging,
, scheduled video meetings, and the practice’s approved systems.

The position will begin with limited access and a defined set of responsibilities. Additional access and duties may be granted after the specialist demonstrates accuracy, reliability, sound judgment, and appropriate handling of protected health information.



Application Requirements

Applicants should submit:

• A résumé describing relevant medical-billing and insurance experience.

• A brief explanation of their behavioral-health billing experience.

• The names of EHRs and clearinghouses they have used.

• The insurance companies and government payers with which they have experience.

• Their experience handling rejected and denied claims.

• Their requested hourly or monthly compensation.

• Their weekly availability and time zone.

• Two professional references, preferably from U.S. healthcare practices.



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short, paid skills assessment using fictional patient and claim information.



Equal Opportunity and Professional Standards

Veritas Psychiatry & Wellness evaluates applicants based on experience, competence, reliability, communication, professionalism, and ability to meet the requirements of the position.

The selected candidate must maintain appropriate professional boundaries and protect the confidentiality of all patient, business, and financial information.

title: Real Estate Video Editor
description:
About us

HD Media House is a fast-growing real estate media agency serving two markets — Seattle/Washington and Sarasota/Florida. We deliver high-quality photo, video, drone, and listing media to top-performing real estate agents and brokerages. We're a creative team building cinematic, story-driven real estate content that helps listings sell faster and makes our clients look exceptional.



Role overview

We are looking for a full-time video editor who knows that great edits aren't about flashy transitions — they're about pacing, emotion, sound, and flow. You will handle the full range of real estate listing videos, from clean basic cuts to cinematic highlight reels and high-end branded productions, as well as short-form social media content designed to stop the scroll. If you live for clean cuts, intentional sequences, beautiful color, and edits that feel premium, you'll fit right in.



Disclaimer: Please do not apply if you do not have prior experience or a portfolio specifically in real estate video editing.



What you'll create

- Cinematic real estate and lifestyle videos that feel modern, polished, and high-end

- Story-driven edits with strong rhythm, pacing, and emotional flow

- Clean, intentional sequences that showcase properties without over-editing

- Color-graded footage using S-Log3, C-Log3, and D-Log M workflows

- Speed ramps with 3D tracking, applied when the story calls for it — never for the sake of it

- Thoughtful sound design that elevates every cut, beat, and transition

- Short-form social media real estate videos optimized for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- You’ll be responsible for producing high-quality, trend-driven real estate videos that showcase strong storytelling, clean pacing, and polished execution. This includes creating engaging on-screen captions, seamless transitions, and impactful sound design, aligned with the style and standards of leading teams such as Fourhorsemen Media and Studio 910



What we're looking for

- Strong experience in Final Cut Pro (preferred), Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve — portfolio required

- Comfortable using MotionVFX or similar cinematic plugins

- A real understanding of storytelling, timing, and visual flow — not just technical editing

- Confident with cinematic color grading and log workflows (S-Log3, C-Log3, D-Log M)

- Knows when to cut, when to hold, and when to let the music breathe

- Actively follows modern real estate, lifestyle, and social video trends

- Can execute speed ramping with 3D tracking cleanly and tastefully

- Detail-obsessed, organized, and consistent with quality — you deliver clean files on time, every time



Your creative toolkit — provided by us

- MotionVFX plugins

- Musicbed

- Artlist



The kind of editor you are

You don't rely on gimmicks. You care about story, mood, pacing, and polish. You know that a great real estate video should feel effortless, premium, and intentional — every frame has a purpose. You think like a storyteller, not just a technician.



Bonus points if you

- Have experience with luxury or high-end real estate content using DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro

- Can do light motion graphics or tasteful title animations

- Experience creating short-form vertical content (Reels, TikTok) with text overlays and trending audio

- Familiar with cloud-based file delivery platforms such as 
, Google Drive, or Dropbox



What we offer

- Consistent volume of projects every week

- Creative toolkit provided — MotionVFX, Musicbed, Artlist

- Collaborative team with clear, direct feedback

- Bi Weekly pay via Paypal

- Work with high-quality, well-shot footage — no salvage jobs



How to apply

Send us your portfolio or showreel and a short introduction video about your experience and the kind of edits you love to create. Tell us what software you work in, what your setup looks like, and your expected rate in USD to 



Let's build work that looks expensive, feels intentional, and actually gets watched.

title: Medicare Lead Generation BONUS!!
description:
# Looking for Someone to Take Over Our Medicare Lead Generation



We've been in business for **10 years**, and we're looking for the right person to come in and take ownership of our Medicare lead generation.



Our business has reached the point where we need someone who can step in, evaluate what we're doing, and build a reliable lead source that keeps our agents busy every day.



I'm **not** looking for someone who claims to know every marketing platform.



I'm looking for someone who has real experience generating Medicare leads through **at least one proven method** and is confident enough to say:



*"I've done this before, and I think I can help your business."*



Maybe your experience is with:



*
 Ads

* Google Ads

* YouTube Ads

* TikTok

* Live transfer campaigns

* Telemarketing

* Direct mail

* SEO

* AI

* Funnels

* Webinars

* Referral systems

* Something completely different



I honestly don't care what your specialty is.



If you know how to generate quality Medicare leads, I want to hear from you.



## The Goal



Our goal is simple.



Build a lead generation system that consistently produces enough qualified Medicare leads to keep **three full-time agents busy every single day.**



If you can help us accomplish that, I'd love to build a long-term relationship with you.



## About Us



We've been helping Medicare clients for over **10 years**, and I'm not looking for someone to complete a short project and disappear.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



I've been hiring remote employees since **2016**, and we currently have **six tea
mbers in the Philippines**. Some of them have been with me for **nearly 10 years**.



We believe in treating good people well.



If you do great work, we'll do everything we can to make sure you're paid fairly, earn your trust, and continue growing together for years to come.



I'm much more interested in finding the right long-term person than someone looking for a quick paycheck.



## Compensation



* **$10 per hour while you're building and testing the system**

* **$1,000 performance bonus** if you successfully build a lead generation system that consistently produces enough Medicare leads to keep our three agents busy.



If you prove yourself, there will absolutely be opportunities to grow your role and your compensation over time.



## Want to Impress Me?



Don't send me a generic application.



Instead, send me a message like you're already my Marketing Director.



Tell me:



* What type of Medicare marketing have you personally done?

* What channel would you focus on first?

* Why do you believe it will work?

* How many leads do you realistically think you could generate?

* How long would it take to get everything launched?

* What budget would you recommend?

* What experience makes you confident this will work?



I want to hear your actual plan.



Pretend you start tomorrow.



Walk me through exactly what you'd do, why you'd do it, and what kind of results you believe you can deliver.



If you've got the experience and the confidence to solve this problem, I'd love to talk with you.

title: Video Editor - 4 Reels/Day for Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
We run an online fitness and body recomposition coaching business serving high-achieving professionals over 40. We're looking for a reliable, fast-turnaround video editor to join our content team and keep our Instagram/Reels engine running daily.



The Role

You'll edit 4 short-form Reels per day (Mon–Fri) from raw footage, talking-head clips. Speed and consistency matter more than flashy effects we need clean, scroll-stopping edits delivered on a daily rhythm.



Responsibilities

Edit 4 Reels/day from raw video and provided scripts/hooks

title: Influencer & UGC Manager
description:
At Luma, a winning UGC ad doesn't start with the editing. It starts with the right creator, briefed right, delivered on time.



We're a creative performance agency for DTC brands, capped at 10 clients. Quality over quantity. We make the ads that win on Meta and scale our clients.



We're looking for a UGC CREATOR MANAGER to own our creator pipeline end to end, long-term. Someone who has already managed real UGC campaigns for e-commerce, knows the sourcing platforms, and thinks performance before vanity.



What you'll own:



- Source US-based UGC creators that match a brief and a customer avatar (we give you the avatar, or you build it from the marketing data we provide)

- Outreach, negotiation, deals: rates, deliverables, deadlines

- Creator payments, clean trackers

- Shipping coordination: collect addresses, send them to the client, track every package until delivery

- Send the briefs (already written by our team) and keep every collab on schedule

- Follow up hard. Creators go silent. You bring them back without burning the relationship.

- Receive the content and QA it against the brief: naming, framing, script, shot list, image and sound

- Approve it or send back precise revision requests

- Drop validated content in the right folder and update the tracker so the editing team can cut it



Who you are:



- Real experience in UGC or influencer coordination for e-commerce (agency or brand side)

- You've used platforms like Insense, Fiverr, Billo, Collabstr, Upwork. Organic DM sourcing on Instagram or others is a big plus.

- Excellent written English. Your outreach messages sell.

- Organized to the extreme. Trackers, naming conventions, deadlines: your comfort zone.

- Marketing sense: you can tell if a video will perform as an ad before anyone edits it

- You take initiative and ask the right questions before problems become urgent

- You can run several brands and 10+ creator collabs in parallel



What we offer:



- $1,500/month

- Full-time: 7 hours a day, Monday to Friday

- Long-term. Committed. Looking for a home, not a side gig.

- We can show proof: we pay our people well, and on time.



To apply: tell us about the last UGC campaign you ran (brand or niche, number of creators, platforms used, results) and send a 2 min loom about your motivation to join us. (start the loom with "Hey lets scale together")



Ps: We can scale together. I want to build a team of navy seals. If you are good and want to have a good rewarding environment, give it a try. Its the place to be.



Luma agency in few words:

Clients: 10 - 8M revenue per month

Team: 15 members: video editor / Graphic designer / Creative strategist

Mindset: Performance, Ownership, No BS, Creativity, Winner.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Logistics Coordinator - Ally Logistics



ABOUT ALLY LOGISTICS:

Ally Logistics is a U.S.-based third-party logistics (3PL) company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Since 2012, we’ve been committed to creating the ultimate freight shipping experience by operating at the optimal intersection of people and technology.

As a full-service 3PL, we specialize in a wide range of freight solutions, including dry van, refrigerated, drayage, straight truck, open deck/flatbed, drop-trailer programs, warehousing, and more. Our diverse service capabilities allow us to support shippers across industries with flexible, reliable, and scalable logistics strategies.

We partner with skilled global talent to support our continued growth and operational excellence, ensuring our customers receive efficient, high-quality service at every step of the supply chain.



ROLE SUMMARY:

The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for ensuring timely and reliable coverage of customer freight by executing same-day or next-day load sourcing with accuracy and urgency. This role manages a high volume of shipments—updating 80–150 loads per day—while maintaining strong communication and operational efficiency. Key responsibilities include coverage on same and next-day loads,  dispatching carriers, performing thorough track-and-trace, extracting and relaying critical customer updates, and sourcing capacity for specific lanes. Success in this position requires exceptional multitasking, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume logistics environment.



JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Under the direction of management, the following outlines the core responsibilities for this position. Duties may evolve based on business needs.

-Manage same-day and next-day freight coverage, including dry van, refrigerated, and other equipment types

-Dispatch drivers and perform proactive track-and-trace for loads and lanes

-Extract and communicate critical customer updates to the internal team

-Effectively manage a high-volume workload - 30-50 loads per day

-Source and secure coverage for lanes and support future projects and initiatives



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs):

-Successfully working with carriers and booking at least 10+ difficult loads per day

-Effectively communicate and manage a high-volume account, supporting 80–150 loads per day with accuracy and responsiveness

-Completing 50–100 outbound calls per day, depending on Aldi volume

-Additional KPIs may be added or adjusted at management’s discretion



REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum of 3 years of experience in logistics/3PL industry, Expeience 1 year in booking/load coverage

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Headset

Professional remote workspace

Ability to work U.S. business hours (EST)

Outlook

Basic CRM or logistics platform

1. Technology & Equipment Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet and computer

2. Availability Requirements

 deliverability: domain auth (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), Mailgun or LC

Automating repetitive recruiting tasks.

Improving recruiter productivity.

Maintaining clean and accurate candidate data.

title: Amazon Product Matching Researcher (Long-Term, Detail-Oriented)
description:
=====================================================

ABOUT THE ROLE

=====================================================



I run an Amazon US business. I source health, skincare and supplement products from a European online pharmacy and resell them on Amazon US.



I need a careful researcher to take products from that pharmacy website and find the matching product on 
 (US), then record the ASIN in a Google Sheet.



This is long-term, ongoing work. I am looking for one reliable person to work with for many months, not a one-time job.



Important: this is repetitive research. ACCURACY MATTERS MUCH MORE THAN SPEED. One wrong ASIN can cost me money, so I would rather you find 30 correct matches than 100 sloppy ones.





=====================================================

IMPORTANT: THE PRODUCT NAMES ARE IN GERMAN

=====================================================



The source website is a German pharmacy. Most product names are written in GERMAN, but you must search on the US Amazon site in English.



You do not need to speak German, but you must be comfortable working around this. Common words you will see:



- Kapseln = capsules

- Tabletten = tablets

- Tropfen = drops

- Salbe = ointment

- Creme = cream

- Nachtcreme = night cream

- Saft = syrup / juice

- Pulver = powder

- Spray = spray

- Loesung = solution

- St / Stueck = pieces (count)

- Nicht vorraetig = OUT OF STOCK (skip these products entirely)



Practical method that works:

1. The BRAND NAME is usually the same in both languages (e.g. La Roche-Posay, Vichy, Weleda, Traumeel, Orthomol). Search by brand first.

2. Use Google Translate for the rest of the product name if needed.

3. Search 
 using: brand + translated product name + size.



If you cannot handle this, please do not apply.





=====================================================

HOW THE PROJECT IS ORGANIZED (PLEASE READ)

=====================================================



The website has tens of thousands of products. We will NOT do all of them at once.



I will assign you ONE BATCH at a time — specific categories, subcategories or brands, with the exact URLs.



Rules:

- Work ONLY on the batch I assign you.

- Do NOT go ahead into other categories on your own.

- Finish the batch, tell me, and I will review it and assign the next one.



This protects both of us: you always know exactly what "done" looks like, and I can check the work properly before we continue.





=====================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO (STEP BY STEP)

=====================================================



1. Open the category/brand page I assigned. Go through it page by page, product by product, in order. Do not skip pages.



2. SKIP any product marked "Nicht vorraetig". That is German for OUT OF STOCK. Only research products that show an "Add to shopping cart" button. Roughly a third of the site is out of stock and I cannot buy those, so researching them wastes your time and my money. Do not record them, and do not count them as "checked" in your Daily Log.



3. For each remaining product, look at the brand, product name and size. (You do NOT need to type these into the sheet — just enough to search with.)



4. Search for that product on 
 (the US site — NOT 
).



5. D
 if there is a valid match, using the rules below.



6. If there IS a match: record the source product URL and the Amazon ASIN in the Google Sheet, plus a one-word note if it is a special case.



7. If there is NO match: move on, no row needed.



8. At the end of each working day, fill in the Daily Log tab (explained below).



Note: the website loads products with JavaScript, so you must use a normal browser (Chrome is fine) and let each page load fully before reading it.





=====================================================

WHAT COUNTS AS A VALID MATCH

=====================================================



A match is valid when it is PHYSICALLY THE SAME PRODUCT — same brand, same item — even if the packaging, quantity, region or photo is different. Judge by the actual product, not by whether the text matches exactly.



VALID (record these):



- Same product, different pack quantity. Source sells 1 unit, Amazon sells a 3-pack. => MATCH. Note: pack



- Same product, slightly different size/volume. Source 50ml, Amazon 75ml. => MATCH. Note: size



- Same product, different regional version. Source is the German/UK/EU version, Amazon has the US version. => MATCH. Note: version



- Outdated photo on Amazon. The Amazon listing still shows an OLD photo even though the product was updated or repackaged. If it is the same product, it still counts. => MATCH. Note: photo



- The Amazon brand field does not exactly match the official brand, but it is genuinely the same physical product (e.g. a reseller listed it under a slightly different brand name). => MATCH. Note: brand



For all of the above, I will personally review each ASIN and d
 whether to buy. Your job is just to find the candidate.



NOT A MATCH (do not record these):



- Genuinely different brand or different manufacturer. A similar product from another company is NOT a match.



- Same brand but a different product line. (e.g. the brand's "Hydrating Serum" is NOT the brand's "Vitamin C Serum")



- Different variant / scent / flavor / formulation. This is a DIFFERENT product. Example: "fragrance-free" version vs "original" version => NOT a match.



- Listings where the Amazon brand shows as "Generic" or has no brand => skip.



- When you are NOT SURE: do NOT force a match. Either skip it, or record it with the note "uncertain" so I can check it myself.



GOLDEN RULE: When in doubt, it is NOT a match. A missed product costs me nothing. A wrong ASIN costs me money. You will never be blamed for saying "I could not find it."





=====================================================

THE GOOGLE SHEET

=====================================================



I will share a Google Sheet with you. It has one tab per category, plus a Daily Log tab.



For each match, fill in only these:



- No.   = row number (already there)

- ASIN  = the Amazon US ASIN of the matching product

- URL   = the source product page URL

- note  = leave BLANK for an exact match. Otherwise write ONE word:

          pack / size / version / photo / brand / uncertain



That is all. No brand names, no product names, no prices, no titles. Just URL + ASIN + a one-word note where it applies. I handle everything else.



If the same ASIN matches more than one source product (for example two different sizes), that is fine — record it on each relevant row.



DAILY LOG TAB (required):

At the end of each working day, add one line:

- Date

- Which category/brand you worked on

- Which pages you covered (e.g. "pages 4 to 11")

- How many products you checked

- How many matches you found



This takes one minute and it is how I confirm coverage. It is a required part of the job.





=====================================================

QUALITY CONTROL — PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY

=====================================================



I want to be completely transparent about how I check the work, so there are no surprises later.



1. RANDOM AUDITS. For every batch, I randomly pick 15-20 rows and personally verify each ASIN against the source product. I do this every single batch, not just at the beginning.



2. CONTROL PRODUCTS. Some batches contain a few products where I already know the correct answer — including some that DO have an Amazon match and some that definitely do NOT. This tells me both whether matches are being invented and whether real matches are being missed through rushing.



3. ERROR THRESHOLDS.

   - Under 5% errors: normal, no problem. Everyone makes some mistakes.

   - 5-10% errors: the batch is returned for rework at no extra pay.

   - Over 10% errors, or any sign that ASINs were entered without actually checking: we stop working together immediately.



4. TIMING. The Google Sheet records edit history. Rows added faster than a human could realistically verify will be treated as fabricated.



None of this is meant to be unfriendly. I am simply telling you upfront exactly how it works, because I plan to work with one person long-term and pay reliably every week. Honest, careful work is genuinely rewarded here.





=====================================================

PAY

=====================================================



- Starting rate: 4 USD per hour

- Hours: 30-40 hours per week

- Paid weekly

- Time tracking: you must use TimeProof (the OnlineJobs.ph time tracker) for all hours worked

- Raise: after 4 weeks, if your audit error rate stays under 5%, I raise your rate to 4.50 USD/hour. Reliable long-term people can go higher from there.

- Bonus: I also give extra bonuses for good work (see below for what "good" means here)



IMPORTANT: I pay for your TIME and your CARE, not per match found.



I do NOT pay more for finding more matches. There is no bonus for a bigger number, and no penalty for reporting "no match found." If a whole page has nothing worth matching, that is a perfectly good result and you will be paid the same. I never want anyone to feel pressure to invent a match.



WHAT THE BONUS IS ACTUALLY BASED ON:

- A low error rate when I audit your rows

- Honestly flagging things as "uncertain" instead of guessing

- Filling in the Daily Log consistently

- Being reliable week to week



In other words, the bonus rewards being CAREFUL, not being FAST. Someone who checks 60 products properly will earn more fro
 over time than someone who rushes through 200 and gets a third of them wrong.





=====================================================

REQUIREMENTS

=====================================================



- Strong attention to detail. This is the single most important quality.

- Able to search on 
 (US site). Your browser must show US prices in USD — if it defaults to another country, set the delivery location to a US ZIP code such as 10001.

- Reliable internet and a normal desktop browser.

- Good written English.

- Comfortable with repetitive research work over long periods.

- Nice to have (not required): experience with Keepa, Amazon arbitrage, or online arbitrage (OA) product research.





=====================================================

HOW TO APPLY

=====================================================



Please send me a reply containing ALL of the following:



1. The word PHARMA at the very top of your message.



2. A short note about your experience with Amazon product research, OA, or Keepa (it is fine if you have none — say so honestly).



3. Confirm you accept the starting rate of 4 USD/hour, 30-40 hours per week, tracked with TimeProof.



4. How many hours per week you can commit, and your usual working hours.



5. A SHORT TEST — please look at these three products and tell me the Amazon US ASIN for each one, or write "no match" if you cannot find one.



PRODUCT 1:





PRODUCT 2:





PRODUCT 3:





For each of the three, please also add ONE sentence explaining how you d
. Note that "no match" is a perfectly acceptable answer for any of them — I want to see your honest judgment, not a guess.



Applications that skip the test or skip the word PHARMA will not be reviewed.



After this, shortlisted applicants will do a small PAID test batch (about 30-50 products) before we begin the ongoing work.

title: US RN - Case Manager
description:
We’re looking for a US-licensed Registered Nurse (USRN) with strong clinical documentation and writing skills to prepare Case Management (CM) reports. This is a remote, flexible opportunity ideal for nurses who excel at reviewing medical documentation and synthesizing complex information into clear, structured narratives.



Deliverables and Responsibilities

Review and summarize provider notes, therapy reports, and assessments.

Prepare accurate case management reports for patients with complex conditions (TBI, SCI, post-MVA, etc.).

Ensure accuracy, clinical consistency, and HIPAA compliance.

Use Advocate Systems (experience preferred but not required).

Document key report sections:

Presenting problem, diagnoses (with ICD-10 codes)

Past medical/surgical history

Medications, allergies, and treatment summaries

Current providers, therapy updates, and progress

SOAP note (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan)

Case management plan with nursing diagnosis, SMART goals, and care strategies



Qualifications:

Active USRN license (required)

Background in case management, utilization review, or clinical writing

Knowledge of medical terminology, care planning, and ICD-10 coding is preferred

Excellent written English and attention to detail

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Work Details

Remote / Work-from-home

Trial task: one CM report to start

Opportunity for long-term collaboration based on performance

Flexible schedule, outcome-focused



Why Work With Us



Join a supportive remote team and use your nursing expertise to make a difference in care coordination and patient outcomes for a diverse caseload. Ideal for USRNs seeking meaningful, flexible work in clinical writing and case management.

title: Local SEO, Google Business Profile and GoHighLevel Specialist
description:
# Local SEO, Google Business Profile and GoHighLevel Specialist



## Position Overview



We are hiring an experienced Local SEO and Google Business Profile Specialist to manage and grow the local search visibility of multiple businesses.



The primary focus of this position is improving Google Business Profile rankings, website rankings, organic lead generation and visibility in AI-generated search results.



This is not an entry-level SEO position. We are looking for someone who already understands the main factors that improve local rankings and can independently develop and execute a strategy.



We do not have time to teach basic Local SEO, backlink building, website optimization or Google Business Profile management. Training materials will be available, but the selected candidate should already possess the experience required to begin contributing.



The right candidate should have documented experience getting businesses into the top three positions of the Google local map pack for competitive keywords.



The secondary focus of the role will be assisting with GoHighLevel, AI tools, automations and basic media buying.



## Primary Business Objective



Our immediate objective is to increase the number of qualified calls generated through Google Business Profiles and organic search.



One of our existing Google Business Profiles currently ranks near the top of the local map pack for several important search terms and generates approximately 24 calls per month.



The goal is to:



* Protect and improve the rankings that are already performing

* Achieve top-three map-pack visibility for additional high-volume keywords

* Expand rankings into additional neighborhoods and service areas

* Increase qualified buyer, seller, investor and property-owner inquiries

* Grow the existing profile from approximately 24 calls per month to more than 50 calls per month

* Build and optimize additional legitimate websites and Google Business Profiles

* Develop multiple profiles that each generate at least 50 inbound calls per month

* Improve the visibility of each business in AI-generated search results and answer engines



The specialist must focus on measurable outcomes, including rankings, qualified calls, appointments, active clients and closed business, not simply completing SEO tasks.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Google Business Profile Optimization



You will be responsible for managing and improving multiple Google Business Profiles.



Responsibilities include:



* Conducting complete Google Business Profile audits

* Improving local map-pack rankings

* Optimizing primary and secondary business categories

* Optimizing services, products, business descriptions and profile information

* Publishing Google Business Profile posts

* Uploading and optimizing relevant photos

* Monitoring profile performance and search queries

* Identifying opportunities to improve calls, clicks and conversions

* Reviewing competitor Google Business Profiles

* Monitoring competitor categories, reviews, content and ranking strategies

* Improving geographic ranking coverage

* Identifying and resolving duplicate-profile or listing-consistency issues

* Assisting with verification, reinstatement or suspension issues when necessary

* Developing review-generation and reputation-management systems

* Improving the quality, frequency and relevance of customer reviews

* Tracking rankings across geographic grids rather than relying on a single manual search



The candidate must also have experience managing and optimizing multiple Google Business Profiles across different locations, with separate tracking, content, citations and ranking strategies for each location.



You should understand how relevance, prominence, proximity, reviews, website authority, citations, content and backlinks affect local rankings.



## Keyword Research and Ranking Strategy



You will be expected to research and prioritize keywords that:



* Trigger the Google local map pack

* Have meaningful local search volume

* Have strong commercial intent

* Can realistically produce calls and qualified leads

* Are relevant to the business location and services

* Have a reasonable path to top-three visibility



You must be able to distinguish between keywords with high search volume and keywords that generate valuable business opportunities.



For each potential keyword, you should evaluate:



* Local search volume

* Search intent

* Whether a map pack appears

* Current ranking position

* Ranking difficulty

* Competitor strength

* Geographic relevance

* Potential business value

* The likelihood of generating qualified calls

* The type of landing page or content required



You should create a focused and prioritized keyword strategy rather than attempting to rank for hundreds of unrelated or low-value keywords.



The complete target keyword list will be shared with the selected candidate after hiring.



## Geographic Rank Tracking



We want rankings measured across the actual target neighborhoods and service areas.



You will be responsible for:



* Setting up local geographic grid tracking

* Monitoring rankings from multiple points within each target neighborhood

* Measuring top-three coverage across the target area

* Identifying geographic areas where rankings are weak

* Creating strategies to expand local visibility

* Reporting ranking improvements and declines

* Comparing our geographic coverage against competitors

* Identifying which keywords have the strongest potential for near-term improvement



Experience with tools such as Local Falcon, Places Scout, BrightLocal or similar platforms is strongly preferred.



## Website and On-Page SEO



You will be responsible for improving the websites connected to each Google Business Profile.



Responsibilities include:



* Conducting technical and on-page SEO audits

* Performing keyword research

* Improving website structure

* Optimizing title tags and meta descriptions

* Optimizing headings and page content

* Improving internal linking

* Optimizing images and alt text

* Implementing relevant schema markup

* Creating service pages

* Creating neighborhood and location pages

* Creating content around high-value customer questions

* Improving website speed and mobile performance

* Identifying crawlability and indexing problems

* Using Google Search Console to monitor performance

* Improving conversion elements and calls to action

* Publishing and updating website content

* Coordinating with developers when technical changes are required



The candidate should be comfortable working inside WordPress and common page builders.



## Local Landing Pages



We plan to create pages targeting specific neighborhoods, services and property types.



You should understand how to create useful local pages without simply duplicating the same content and changing the neighborhood name.



Local pages should include relevant information such as:



* Local market knowledge

* Services offered in the area

* Relevant property or customer types

* Recently completed work or transactions

* Frequently asked questions

* Neighborhood-specific information

* Supporting images and media

* Internal links

* Clear calls to action

* Conversion-focused contact options



Each page should be designed to support Google Business Profile rankings, organic rankings, lead generation and AI search visibility.



## Content Creation and Optimization



You will be expected to either write strong English-language content or manage the content-production process.



Responsibilities include:



* Developing content calendars

* Creating service-page content

* Creating neighborhood content

* Writing articles and guides

* Updating existing content

* Creating FAQ sections

* Optimizing content for search intent

* Creating content that demonstrates experience and authority

* Adding internal links

* Researching competitor content

* Identifying content gaps

* Supporting both local and broader organic rankings

* Using AI responsibly without publishing generic or low-quality content



Content should be written for both search engines and potential customers.



## Backlink Acquisition



Backlink building is an important part of this role.



You should have experience acquiring legitimate and relevant backlinks through methods such as:



* Local partnerships

* Industry websites

* Local organizations

* Guest contributions

* Digital public relations

* Sponsorships

* Business directories

* Local media

* Community websites

* Resource pages

* Professional associations

* Competitor backlink research

* Direct outreach



You will be responsible for:



* Developing a backlink-acquisition strategy

* Conducting competitor backlink analysis

* Identifying quality opportunities

* Performing outreach

* Tracking acquired links

* Evaluating link quality

* Monitoring referring-domain growth

* Measuring whether acquired links improve rankings and authority

* Avoiding spammy or high-risk backlink practices



We are not looking for someone who only purchases low-quality backlinks or submits websites to hundreds of irrelevant directories.



## Citations and Local Authority



Responsibilities include:



* Auditing existing citations

* Correcting inconsistent business information

* Building relevant local and industry citations

* Monitoring name, address and phone-number consistency

* Identifying duplicate listings

* Building location-specific authority

* Tracking citation progress

* Evaluating citation quality rather than only quantity

* Identifying trusted local and industry platforms where the business should be listed



## AEO and AI Search Optimization



We want all businesses and websites to become more visible in answer engines and AI-generated search results.



This includes platforms and features such as:



* Google AI Overviews

* ChatGPT

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Bing Copilot

* Other AI-driven search platforms



Responsibilities include:



* Structuring content so AI platforms can understand and reference it

* Improving business and entity consistency

* Creating authoritative question-and-answer content

* Implementing relevant schema markup

* Improving citations and third-party mentions

* Building topical authority

* Monitoring whether the business appears in AI-generated answers

* Identifying opportunities for the business to be referenced by trusted websites

* Developing measurable AEO reporting

* Improving brand and business mentions across the web

* Comparing AI visibility against competitors



The candidate should understand that AEO requires more than simply adding FAQ schema or mentioning keywords.



## Call Tracking and Lead Quality



The goal is not simply to generate more calls. We want more qualified calls.



You will assist with tracking calls from each profile, website, location and marketing channel.



Calls should be categorized based on the type and quality of the inquiry, including:



* Prospective customer

* Existing customer

* Qualified lead

* Unqualified lead

* High-value service inquiry

* Lower-value inquiry

* Referral

* Vendor

* Irrelevant

* Missed

* Unidentified



We want to understand which profiles, neighborhoods, pages and keyword groups generate actual business.



The specialist should help connect marketing performance to the full customer journey:



Call

Qualified lead

Consultation

Active client

Contract or sale

Revenue



## GoHighLevel Responsibilities



A secondary part of this role will involve managing and improving GoHighLevel.



Responsibilities may include:



* Managing GoHighLevel subaccounts

* Creating forms and surveys

* Building landing pages

* Setting up pipelines

* Creating calendars

* Building workflows

* Setting up SMS automations

* Setting up
 automations

* Creating missed-call text-back workflows

* Creating appointment reminders

* Building lead-nurture campaigns

* Creating long-term follow-up campaigns

* Creating review-request workflows

* Creating lead-reactivation campaigns

* Testing workflow triggers and conditions

* Troubleshooting automation problems

* Maintaining clear workflow documentation

* Connecting third-party tools when necessary



Candidates should provide examples of GoHighLevel automations they have personally built.



## AI Tools and AI Studio



The specialist may also assist with AI-related tools inside or connected to GoHighLevel.



This may include:



* AI Studio

* Conversation AI

* Voice AI

* AI receptionist tools

* Lead qualification systems

* Automated SMS responses

* Automated
 responses

* Appointment-booking systems

* AI knowledge bases

* Prompt development

* Testing AI responses

* Improving automation accuracy

* Connecting AI tools to CRM workflows



Advanced AI-development experience is not required, but the candidate should be comfortable learning and managing AI marketing tools.



## Media Buying



Media buying is a secondary responsibility.



Experience with the following is helpful:



* Google Ads

* Local Services Ads

* Meta Ads

* Retargeting

* Lead-form campaigns

* Landing-page optimization

* Conversion tracking

* Call tracking



The candidate does not need to be an expert media buyer if they have excellent Local SEO skills.



Local SEO and Google Business Profile ranking experience are the highest priorities.



## Required Qualifications



Candidates must have:



* Proven Local SEO experience

* Proven Google Business Profile optimization experience

* Documented examples of achieving top-three map-pack rankings

* Experience improving Google Business Profile calls and leads

* Experience managing multiple Google Business Profiles across different locations

* Strong understanding of local ranking factors

* Experience with on-page SEO

* Experience with technical SEO

* Experience with off-page SEO

* Experience acquiring backlinks

* Experience building citations

* Experience conducting keyword research

* Experience analyzing competitors

* Experience creating or managing SEO content

* Experience using Google Search Console

* Experience using Google Analytics

* Experience using Google Business Profile Performance

* Strong written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to manage several websites and profiles

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to prioritize high-impact work

* Ability to explain the strategy behind recommendations



## Preferred Qualifications



The following experience is preferred:



* Real estate SEO

* Legal SEO

* Home-services SEO

* Professional-services SEO

* WordPress

* GoHighLevel

* Local Falcon

* Places Scout

* BrightLocal

* Semrush

* Ahrefs

* Whitespark

* Screaming Frog

* Google Keyword Planner

* Google Tag Manager

* CallRail or similar call-tracking software

* Schema implementation

* Conversion-rate optimization

* Google Ads

* Local Services Ads

* AI Studio

* Conversation AI

* Voice AI

* API and Zapier integrations



## Performance Metrics



Performance will be measured based on outcomes, including:



* Maintaining and improving existing top-three rankings

* Achieving top-three visibility for additional high-value keywords

* Increasing geographic top-three map coverage

* Increasing monthly Google Business Profile calls

* Growing an existing profile from approximately 24 calls to more than 50 calls per month

* Increasing qualified inquiries

* Improving the percentage of calls that represent valuable business opportunities

* Increasing website traffic

* Increasing organic calls and form submissions

* Improving conversion rates

* Increasing the number of quality referring domains

* Improving citation consistency

* Improving website technical health

* Increasing indexed and ranking pages

* Increasing AEO and AI-search visibility

* Successfully completing and maintaining GoHighLevel automations



## Reporting Requirements



The candidate must provide a clear weekly report containing:



* Work completed

* Current keyword rankings

* Ranking gains and losses

* Geographic grid-ranking changes

* Google Business Profile actions completed

* Website changes completed

* Content created or updated

* Backlinks acquired

* Citations created or corrected

* Calls generated

* Qualified leads generated

* GoHighLevel work completed

* Problems or blockers

* Priorities for the following week



A monthly report should summarize:



* Overall ranking changes

* Top-three keyword coverage

* Geographic ranking improvements

* Call and lead growth

* Traffic growth

* Conversion growth

* Backlink growth

* AEO visibility

* Work completed against the monthly plan

* Recommended next steps



Reports should focus on results and decision-making, not simply list hours worked.



## First 30 Days



During the first 30 days, the selected candidate will be expected to:



* Audit the existing Google Business Profile

* Audit the existing website

* Review current rankings for the target keyword portfolio

* Set up geographic grid tracking

* Review Google Business Profile search-query data

* Review current call performance

* Audit competitors

* Audit citations

* Audit backlinks

* Audit existing website content

* Review technical SEO issues

* Identify the highest-impact ranking opportunities

* Create a prioritized 90-day Local SEO plan

* Begin implementing the highest-priority improvements

* Establish clear baseline reporting



The candidate should be able to explain why a profile ranks well for certain keywords but has limited visibility for other related search terms.



## What We Are Not Looking For



Please do not apply if you:



* Only have beginner-level SEO knowledge

* Need extensive training before you can begin

* Have never ranked a Google Business Profile

* Cannot provide examples of previous results

* Only understand basic keyword placement

* Focus primarily on posting blogs without a complete SEO strategy

* Use spammy backlinks

* Use automated link-building tools without reviewing quality

* Publish unedited AI content

* Only report activities instead of results

* Require daily instructions

* Cannot independently identify ranking problems

* Make unrealistic ranking guarantees

* Cannot explain what you personally did on previous campaigns



## Application Requirements



To apply, please send the following:



1. A summary of your Local SEO experience.



2. Two to five examples of businesses you helped rank in the Google local map pack.



3. Screenshots or reports showing ranking improvements.



4. The keywords and locations you ranked.



5. The approximate ranking positions before and after your work.



6. The amount of time required to achieve the results.



7. A clear explanation of what work you personally completed.



8. Examples of improvements in calls, traffic or qualified leads.



9. An example of a backlink strategy you implemented.



10. An example of a Local SEO content strategy you implemented.



11. A list of Local SEO, reporting and website tools you have used.



12. Examples of GoHighLevel workflows or automations you built.



13. Your experience with AI Studio, Conversation AI or Voice AI.



14. Your experience managing multiple Google Business Profiles across different locations.



15. Your availability and preferred working hours.



16. Your desired hourly or monthly compensation.



## Required Application Question



Begin your application with the word **“MAPS”** so we know you carefully reviewed the complete job description.



Then answer the following scenario:



A local professional-services business has one Google Business Profile that ranks in the top three for two broad neighborhood keywords and generates approximately 24 calls per month.



The profile does not rank in the top three for several other related keywords that have confirmed search volume and trigger the local map pack. The business wants to increase the profile to more than 50 calls per month while improving the percentage of qualified, higher-value inquiries.



What information would you review first, and what would your first five priorities be during the initial 30 days?



Please explain:



* Which data and tools you would use

* How you would determine why the profile ranks for some searches but not others

* How you would prioritize the available keyword opportunities

* What changes you would consider making to the GBP and website

* How you would measure whether your strategy is working



Generic answers that do not demonstrate practical Local SEO experience will not be considered.



## Paid Trial Assignment



Final candidates may be asked to complete a paid trial assignment.



The assignment may include reviewing one website and Google Business Profile and identifying:



* The five highest-impact problems

* The five highest-impact opportunities

* Current keyword and geographic ranking weaknesses

* The first 30 days of recommended work

* A backlink strategy

* A content strategy

* A plan for increasing calls

* A plan for improving lead quality

* A plan for improving AI-search visibility

* The tools and access required to begin



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is an experienced Local SEO operator who understands that the objective is not merely to publish content, build random backlinks or complete a checklist.



The objective is to achieve top-three map-pack rankings, generate qualified inbound calls, improve organic visibility, build website authority and create repeatable systems that can be expanded across multiple businesses and locations.



This person should be proactive, analytical, organized and able to work with limited supervision.



They should be able to review a business, determine what is preventing it from ranking, create a strategy and independently execute the work required to produce measurable results.

The Distribution Assistant supports the day-to-day management of distribution systems across The Set Collection member hotels. 



Working closely with the Distribution team, this role assists with maintaining rate and inventory connectivity, supporting hotel onboarding, troubleshooting distribution issues, and ensuring the accurate configuration of channels, GDS, and consortia programmes. The role acts as a key point of coordination between member hotels, system providers, and internal stakeholders to help maximise distribution performance and maintain data integrity.





Key Responsibilities:



• Support the daily operation of distribution systems, including CRS, GDS, channel managers and third-party distribution platforms.

• Perform regular audits of rates, amenities, benefits and distribution configurations to ensure accuracy and consistency.

• Maintain distribution documentation, trackers and operational procedures.

• Assist with implementing new distribution initiatives, integrations and system enhancements.

• Respond to member hotel enquiries regarding distribution, connectivity and booking channel performance.

• Support the maintenance of luxury travel programme configurations, including consortia and preferred partner programmes.

• Produce reports and provide administrative support for the Distribution team as required.

• Collaborate with internal teams including Commercial, Member Services, Sales and Marketing to ensure accurate distribution information across all channels.

• Maintain a high level of data accuracy and ensure all updates are completed within agreed service levels.









• Develop an effective and efficient Distribution strategy for the Set.

• Extensive GDS knowledge, including Sabre Mosaic & SynXis is mandatory

• Take ownership of Leonardo/L

title: Fast growing Australian property management business, looking for our next hire
description:
We are a company called Toohey Property Management based in Brisbane, Australia. Since two years ago, we've grown very quickly due to our customer focus and are now looking to bring on another virtual assistant to become part of the team. The role we are looking to fill involves working closely with me, the founder of the business, as a virtual assistant in a long-term position.



I'm a people-focused person and I understand that the culture we have inside our company is what we bring to our clients, so I'm always looking to support my people and create a positive environment.



I've run multiple companies in the past where I've worked with some remote staff that I've been able to get to know on a personal level. I still keep in touch with these people to this day and have fantastic relationships with them.



Now, at this stage in my life, I'd like to run this business for the rest of my working life and bring it to a point where I'm really happy with the people involved.



The main elements of the role involves:

- Filling out documents on my behalf while communicating with me over text message or phone call if I'm not in the office and out in meetings.

- Updating the internal systems with recent changes and updates that come in via the various communication channels 

- Speaking with tenants on the phone line to answer questions, also planning with contractors who are completing jobs at properties we manage on the phone

- Receipting rent money paid into our bank account to the relevant property owner.



I'll guide you through how to do these elements of the role, and if you are attentive and persistent, you'll be able to learn this very quickly. We have plenty of training videos made personally by me that I recorded very recently. 



Your typical day at Toohey Property Management would look like:

- Start by joining a video call with me and the rest of the team where we plan out the day and answer any questions you might have

- Begin working on any requests I've sent through over whatsapp or

- After you've finished that, possibly answering a phone call that comes in to the office or doing an outbound call to an external company we need to speak with

- This would be around lunch time when you would take a break

- After lunch there would be some
s you will need to handle that might involve updating different systems and actioning next steps

- After those
s, you would then begin receipting any rent money that was paid into our account that day

- Then at the end of the day we'd touch base and have a conversation about how the day went, what worked and what didn't work.



I look forward to hearing back about this opportunity. It's truly exciting and has some great upward potential for salary growth if the employee is able to do a good job and shows commitment.



If you're interested. Please
 me directly to 
 with your CV and a short video telling me more about you, your current work from home set up, what kind of hours you would like to work, when you would like to start and what excites you about the role. The video should be about 3 minutes. In your
, please also let me know a suitable time you can have a video interview with me in (Brisbane, Australia time).
