title: Microsoft Power Platform Engineer
description:
Mindcore Technologies, a US-based technology services provider, is hiring a senior Microsoft Power Platform engineer to lead the build of a multi-system operations automation program for an enterprise healthcare client. You will own the core platform: the Dataverse data model, Power Automate flows, Azure services, SharePoint, and Copilot Studio agents, all in a HIPAA-regulated environment.



This is a 4-month contract.



This is a hands-on build and architecture role, not a coordination role. You will work alongside Mindcore's technical leads and a dedicated Automation engineer.



What you will build:

-Dataverse data model: custom tables, columns, relationships, and row-level security scoped by user role

-Power Automate cloud flows: scheduled syncs, exception detection, error handling, retries, and Teams notifications

-Azure services: Key Vault for secrets, Service Bus queues, Monitor and Log Analytics for audit logging

-SharePoint Online: communication sites, document libraries, and operational lists

-Copilot Studio agents connected to Power Automate through Direct Line

-PHI separation and HIPAA-aligned audit logging across every workflow





Required skills:

-4+ years building on Microsoft Power Platform in production

-Power Automate: complex cloud flows, premium connectors, robust error handling

-Dataverse: schema design, security roles, row-level security

-Azure: Key Vault, Service Bus, Monitor (working proficiency)

-SharePoint Online configuration

-Experience handling regulated or sensitive data (HIPAA, healthcare, finance, or equivalent)

-Fluent written and spoken English

-Daily overlap with US Eastern time

-Power BI: DAX, semantic models, row-level security (a later program phase)

-Healthcare or homecare systems (EVV, scheduling, billing)

-Microsoft certifications (PL-400, PL-600, AZ-204)

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
You are the third engineer on our AI automation team. Two engineers already own marketing and finance automation. You are the flexible builder: you drop into whichever department has the highest-leverage system to ship next, architect it end to end, deploy it to run on its own, and document it so the team can maintain and scale it.



This is not a task-queue job. You are hired as a builder and an innovator. When there is no active request, your job is to find the next process worth automating and prototype it.



Please apply here and send portfolios and resumes to: 



What You Will Do:

-Architect and deploy automation using Claude (API + Skills), n8n, and custom code

-Build AI agents and workflows that run persistently on our cloud environment (Azure Virtual Desktop) — no manual daily triggering

-Integrate APIs and OAuth flows across the stack: GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, WordPress, QuickBooks/NetSuite, Microsoft 365, and others

-Write custom Python or Node.js where a clean n8n node does not exist — connectors, data transforms, webhooks

-Build Claude Skills that encode our processes and brand standards into repeatable, documented systems

-Document every build to our standard structure so any engineer can step in cold

Proactively surface automation opportunities and present at least one new idea or improvement each week



How We Work:

-Every automation follows the same pattern: data source ? n8n orchestration ? staging ? Claude processing ? delivered output, with a human review gate before anything goes public. Claude is our primary engine; n8n is the backbone; custom code fills the gaps. Everything runs on the AVD. Everything is documented.



Required Skills — Non-Negotiable:

You must already be able to do these without supervision:



-n8n in production — webhooks, API nodes, branching/conditionals, error handling and retries, OAuth. Tutorial-only experience will not pass screening.

-LLM API integration — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent, including prompt design and agent/workflow logic. We are Claude-first; you must be ready to build that way.

-Custom code — Python and/or Node.js for connectors, transformations, and scripting

APIs and auth — REST, JSON, API keys/tokens, OAuth flows

-Cloud/remote infrastructure — comfortable working on a remote desktop or VPS, with Git and VS Code

-Strong written English and the discipline to document what you build



Nice to Have:

-MCP servers, 
, Zapier

-MSP or IT-services background



Who Should NOT Apply:

-You have only followed tutorials and cannot explain how your own workflows work

-You need constant supervision and clear tickets to do anything

-You want guaranteed pay without showing results



What You Get:

-A long-term, full-time role on a funded, growing AI team — not a one-off gig

-Real ownership: you will become the track owner for whole departments



Paid twice a month, on time, via your preferred method

, and other communication channels

* Assist customers with questions regarding services, billing, invoices, and accounts

* Handle customer concerns professionally and efficiently

* Follow up with customers when needed

* Schedule appointments and coordinate with internal teams

* Maintain accurate customer records and CRM information

* Perform general administrative and virtual assistant tasks



### Accounting & Bookkeeping Support



* Create and process invoices

* Record and track payments

* Assist with Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable

* Follow up on outstanding invoices and customer balances

* Assist with billing and collections

* Reconcile transactions and financial records

* Perform data entry and maintain accurate accounting records

* Assist with basic bookkeeping and financial reporting

* Work with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software

* Prepare spreadsheets and reports as needed



## Requirements



* **2+ years of relevant experience** in accounting, bookkeeping, billing, accounts receivable, collections, or financial administration

* Previous experience in **customer service, virtual assistance, or administrative support**

* Experience with **QuickBooks Online** is strongly preferred

* Strong understanding of basic accounting and bookkeeping principles

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong communication and customer service skills

* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM systems, and online software

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home setup

* Willingness to work during US business hours



## Preferred Experience



Candidates with experience in any of the following are highly encouraged to apply:



* QuickBooks Online

* Bookkeeping

* Accounts Receivable

* Accounts Payable

* Billing and Invoicing

* Collections

* Customer Service

* Virtual Assistance

* Administrative Support

* CRM systems

* Home service or other US-based businesses



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is more than just an entry-level VA. The ideal candidate has real-world experience handling both **customer communication and accounting-related responsibilities**.



You should be someone who is:



* **Reliable** — You show up on time and follow your schedule.

* **Online** — You have a dependable internet connection and backup plans when necessary.

* **On Task** — You remain focused and productive during working hours.

* **Detail-Oriented** — You understand that accuracy is critical when handling customer and financial information.

* **Proactive** — You can identify problems and take action without waiting to be told every step.

* **Professional** — You communicate clearly and represent the company well when dealing with customers.

Please submit your application with:



1. Your updated resume

2. A brief summary of your relevant accounting, bookkeeping, customer service, or VA experience

4. Your preferred hourly rate

5. Your availability and the hours you can work in US time zones

title: YouTube Explainer Video Editor
description:
# YouTube Explainer Video Editor — Simple Animated History Videos



We are looking for a creative and reliable video editor for a new faceless YouTube channel about ancient humans, evolution, survival, animals and early history.



You must be able to create videos in the same general format as this reference:







Please watch the reference before applying.



This is **not** a cinematic stock-footage documentary position. The videos will use a simple, fast-paced animated explainer format.



## Editing Style



The videos should use:



* Simple illustrated or stick-figure-style characters

* Flat vector graphics and icons

* Basic historical illustrations

* Simple maps and timelines

* Diagrams that explain what the narrator is saying

* Bold on-screen words and numbers

* Cut-out images with transparent backgrounds

* Basic pop-in, slide-in and movement animations

* Visual jokes and exaggerated illustrations where appropriate

* Frequent visual changes to keep viewers watching



The animation does not need to be advanced. Most scenes can be created by moving, resizing, rotating or replacing static illustrated elements.



The priority is making every section of the voiceover easy and entertaining to understand.



## Example



For a section explaining how ancient humans tamed wolves, you might show:



* A simple illustrated wolf standing outside a human camp

* Food scraps appearing beside the camp

* A nervous wolf running away

* A calmer wolf moving toward the food

* A basic generation timeline

* Several wolves gradually changing into early dogs

* Key words or arrows appearing to explain the process



The visuals should follow the narration closely rather than showing random stock footage.



## What We Provide



For every video, we will provide:



* The video idea

* The finished script

* The completed voiceover

* A title

* A reference video or style guidance



## Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Turning the voiceover into a complete animated explainer video

* Planning suitable visuals for each sentence or section

* Sourcing or creating simple characters, icons, maps and illustrations

* Removing backgrounds from images when necessary

* Maintaining a consistent visual style throughout the video

* Adding basic movement and animation to otherwise static assets

* Adding relevant text, labels, arrows and diagrams

* Synchronising every visual closely with the voiceover

* Changing or updating the visuals approximately every 3–5 seconds

* Creating a strong visual hook during the opening

* Exporting the final video in 1920 × 1080, 16:9 YouTube format

* Making reasonable revisions when required



You may use tools such as:



* CapCut

* Adobe After Effects

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Canva

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Freepik

* Envato Elements

* Vyond

* Animaker

* Similar animation or design tools



You may also use AI tools to help create individual illustrations, but the final video must maintain a clean and consistent illustrated style. It should not look like a collection of unrelated AI images.



## Workload



We plan to publish:



**Three videos per week**



Each video will be approximately:



**15–20 minutes long**



You must be able to deliver consistently and communicate clearly if there are any problems.



## Starting Payment



The starting budget is:



**$10 per completed video**



This equals:



**$30 per week for four completed videos**



This is a new YouTube channel with a limited starting budget. Once the channel becomes monetised and generates revenue, we intend to increase the payment for a reliable editor who has helped us build the channel.



Performance bonuses may also be paid when videos achieve strong results.



Please only apply if you understand and accept the starting budget.



## Requirements



* Experience creating animated explainer videos

* Ability to source or create simple vector-style visual assets

* Good visual storytelling skills

* Strong understanding of YouTube pacing and audience retention

* Ability to match visuals closely to a voiceover

* Consistent design and character style

* Reliable communication

* Ability to complete four videos per week

* Willingness to follow a reference style

* Attention to historical details



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Two or three examples of animated explainer videos you have edited

2. The editing and animation software you use

3. The websites or tools you use to source illustrations and vector assets

4. Confirmation that you watched the reference video

5. Confirmation that you can produce four videos per week

6. Confirmation that you accept the starting rate of $10 per video

7. A brief explanation of how you would illustrate ancient humans gradually turning wolves into dogs



Please begin your application with:



**WOLF TO DOG**



Applications that do not include these words will not be considered.



This is intended to become a long-term position for the right editor.

title: Reddit community manager
description:
We're a small health/wellness brand and we're building out our presence on Reddit as one of our main channels. Looking for someone who actually knows Reddit, not a general "social media person" who'll treat it like Instagram.



Here's the thing we care about most: we want someone who can build community two ways at once. One is around the topic/niche itself — being genuinely useful in the wider conversation, showing up in the right threads, understanding what people in this space actually talk about and worry about. The other is around our brand specifically — running our own subreddit, making it a place people want to be, turning it into something that supports the business. Both matter. If you only know how to do brand cheerleading, or only know how to lurk in big subs, this probably isn't the fit.



We want you to take full ownership of our subreddit. Not "wait for tasks" ownership — actual ownership. You treat it like it's yours: you know what's happening in it every day, you spot problems before we do, you bring us ideas instead of waiting for a brief.



And running our own sub is only half of it. We want someone who's always testing ways to bring new people in — cross-promotion with other communities, showing up and genuinely helping in other subreddits, finding where our future customers already hang out and earning a place in those conversations. We expect you to come with hypotheses, try them, and tell us what worked.



The other big piece is brand mentions. When someone talks about us anywhere on Reddit — a question, a complaint, a "has anyone tried these guys" — we want to be there. That means monitoring mentions and actually replying to people even when they didn't post in our sub. Fast, human, honest, and always disclosed.



What you'd be doing, day to day:



- Owning and running our subreddit end to end (structure, rules, content, moderation, the whole thing)

- Replying to people fast — we care a lot about not leaving posts sitting there ignored

- Creating content and the visuals to go with it (we don't want to wait on a designer for every post)

- Monitoring brand mentions across Reddit and responding wherever they show up

- Testing acquisition ideas — cross-promo, helpful participation in other communities — and reporting back on what moved the needle

- Keeping an eye on competitor subs and the broader niche, and telling us what you're seeing



What we're looking for:



- You have a real Reddit account with history. You get Reddit culture — you know why people here hate obvious marketing, and you know transparency is the only thing that works

- You've grown or managed a subreddit or community before

- You're comfortable working disclosed and above-board (no fake accounts, no astroturfing — it doesn't work in our space and we won't do it)

- Bonus if you've worked with a wellness niche or health brand before, or at least understand that some niches need a careful hand



How this works: we'd start small and paid — a first project to set up the page and put together a strategy. If that goes well and we're on the same page, we move to an ongoing monthly arrangement. Basically the first bit is a paid trial for both of us.



A few quick questions — please answer these in your reply:



1. Which communities/subreddits have you managed or worked in? (Name them if you can.)

2. What exactly were your responsibilities there? Walk us through what you actually did day to day, in detail — not just "community management."

3. What metrics did you track?

4. How did your work move those metrics? Be specific about cause and effect where you can.



Short and real beats a long polished pitch. Drop your Reddit profile if you're able to, and roughly what you'd charge monthly.

I'm setting up a digital learning platform (an online course academy) for a client, and I'm looking for a WordPress specialist who has configured LMS and WooCommerce setups like this before. This platform is the first project, but I'm hiring for the long term, with several more tasks and projects to follow.

A learner buys a course, gets access to modules that unlock over time, tracks their progress, takes self-check quizzes, and downloads a certificate on completion. There's a separate area for instructors, and payments include an installment option.



What you'll do



- Set up WordPress on hosting with a staging environment

- Configure an LMS (Tutor LMS or LearnDash): course / module / chapter structure, scheduled (drip) content release, progress tracking, quizzes, certificates

- Set up WooCommerce and payments: checkout, multiple payment methods, a roughly 6-month installment option, and access tied to payment status (access pauses automatically if an installment fails)

- Configure user roles for learners and instructors, including an instructor dashboard

- Set up an internal, private 1:1 messaging channel between learners and instructors (a plugin, or light customization if no plugin fits cleanly)

- Make the plugins work together cleanly and test everything thoroughly: test purchases, failed-installment scenarios, access rules



What you won't do



- Design and branding. That's handled in-house.

- Course content and copywriting. That's provided by us.

- Build a whole system from scratch. The foundation is established plugins. Custom code within them (hooks, template overrides and CSS) is part of the job, see must-haves.



Must-haves



- Demonstrable experience setting up WordPress with an LMS (Tutor LMS or LearnDash) and WooCommerce, ideally including Subscriptions and Memberships

- You have built payment / installment flows before, with membership access tied to payment status

- Solid coding skills, at least advanced. You can write custom code where configuration isn't enough: plugin and theme customizations via hooks, template overrides, and custom CSS

- Fluent, hands-on use of Claude Code and Codex as agentic tools. In your application, include one concrete example: a real task you used them for, what you built or solved, and how the tool actually helped. Applications without this example will not be considered

- A careful, test-driven way of working. You don't call a payment flow "done" without running the failure cases

- You understand and speak English confidently (we'll have calls) and write clearly in English



Nice to have



- Experience with reseller checkouts (Digistore24, CopeCart, ablefy) and their webhooks

- Elementor

- Familiarity with GDPR / DSGVO and EU hosting

- German language



This role



I'm hiring for a long-term collaboration, not a one-off. The course platform is the first task, and there will be several more projects to work on together. I want someone reliable I can keep working with regularly.



How we work



I care about quality and clear standards, so I work with Hubstaff for time tracking. Hours and work stay transparent on both sides. If you're comfortable working this way, we'll get along well.



How to apply



Please send your application to 
 with:



- A short note on 2-3 similar LMS or membership projects you've set up (links if possible)

- Your Claude Code / Codex example (see must-haves)

- Your rate or how you prefer to charge, and your availability

description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar

- Log every call outcome in our CRM



**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

title: Programme & Events Manager
description:
Reports to: CEO

Works closely with: CEO, Advisory Board, Digital Operations Lead, pilot clients, event partners and speakers

Location: Remote - Philippines-based candidates

Team: UK and Philippines-based

Hours: Full-time, 8:30am–5:00pm UK time



ABOUT SUPERWELLNESS



Founded in 2011, SuperWellness has worked with over 1,500 organisations on workplace wellbeing. Along the way, we've come to believe the industry has had it slightly wrong: wellbeing has too often been treated as a separate concern from performance — focused on minimising risk and supporting those in crisis — rather than as two sides of the same coin. Our mission is to help organisations build compassionate, high-performance cultures — where good work is celebrated not just for preventing harm, but for enabling people and organisations to genuinely flourish. That mission is what's driving the launch of an exciting new programme and the events built around it.

We're just as invested in the growth of our own team. We focus on developing our people and bringing out their potential, and we value initiative, creativity, and people who actively want to contribute to our mission rather than simply carry out tasks.



ABOUT THE ROLE



SuperWellness is launching an exciting new workplace wellbeing programme, alongside a flagship summit bringing together around 100 senior leaders in London in February 2027.

We're looking for someone to project-manage this launch from the ground up — coordinating the moving parts across our Advisory Board, pilot clients, partners, and the summit itself — and then to take ongoing ownership of the programme once launched: managing it year-round, and planning and delivering future events. This is a permanent role built around a major first-year launch, not a fixed-term project. You'll work closely with the CEO on the commercial and strategic decisions that shape it. It's not a role where you wait to be told what to do next — it's a role where you own workstreams, spot what needs attention before it becomes a problem, and bring your own judgement to how things should be done.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Launch project management

• Project manage the end-to-end launch of the programme and the delivery of the launch summit (4 February 2027, London) — timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk-flagging

• Set up and maintain reporting on launch progress and event take-up, keeping the CEO informed of where things stand and what needs a decision



Ongoing programme management

• Once launched, take ownership of managing the programme year-round

• Plan and project manage future events on an ongoing basis, applying the same reporting and delivery approach used for the launch



Advisory board coordination

• Liaise with Advisory Board members to coordinate meeting dates and diaries

• Coordinate board members' input into the framework and supporting documentation

• Support board members' social media activity connected to the launch and future events



Partnership & sponsorship

• Help develop and progress partnership and sponsorship opportunities alongside the CEO

• Support outreach, follow-up, and coordination with prospective partners



Pilot client liaison

• Liaise with pilot clients on deadlines through the programme process

• Coordinate queries and support to keep pilot clients on track to completion



Event delivery

• Liaise with the venue, speakers, and other stakeholders for the launch summit and future events on logistics and requirements



Marketing & communications

• Project manage marketing communications around the launch and future events — social media,
 campaigns, and PR — working closely with the CEO and Digital Operations Lead



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



This is a project ownership role, not an administrative one. We're looking for someone who can learn quickly under guidance, take genuine ownership of significant parts of the launch, and add value by contributing their own thinking — not just executing instructions.



• Proven project management experience — you have managed a significant project before, ideally something comparable in scale and complexity to a conference, product launch, or major campaign

• Extremely well organised — juggling multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines without things slipping through the cracks is second nature to you

• Fully fluent in English, with an excellent command of written English — able to tailor AI-generated content so it sounds authentic and reflects our brand's voice, not generic or robotic

• High level of business and commercial awareness — you understand how partnerships, sponsorship, and programme delivery create value, and you bring that awareness to how you handle every conversation

• Highly proactive and able to work independently — comfortable making decisions without close supervision, and confident enough to challenge existing approaches and bring new ideas to the table rather than just following instructions

• Comfortable liaising directly and confidently with senior stakeholders — board members, sponsors, and pilot clients — representing the brand professionally

• A self-starter who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next



Please note: this role requires genuine project ownership and independent judgement. If you are looking for a purely administrative or task-execution role, this is unlikely to be the right fit.



WORKING HERE



• This is a remote role working closely with a small, fast-moving UK and Philippines-based team — expect regular real-time collaboration during UK hours

• You will be expected to provide your own professional-spec, reliable equipment — a capable laptop, stable broadband connection, and a suitable working environment. Salary is set to reflect that no equipment allowance is provided

• You'll be working on something genuinely new — a major programme launched from the ground up — with real scope to shape how it's delivered



SALARY & BENEFITS



• $1,200–$1,500 per month, depending on experience

• Quarterly profit-related bonus, tied to your personal KPIs as well as overall company performance

• Growth shares after 6 months — eligibility to join our growth share scheme, giving you a stake in the company's long-term growth

• HMO cover after 6 months



HOW TO APPLY



To apply for this position, please complete this application form: 



Please note that only candidates who fully complete the application form will be considered for the role. Please do not apply directly via onlinejobs.ph as your application will not be considered.



Stage 1 — Application, including our application form, a CV, cover letter, and a short video.

Stage 2 — Initial 10-minute video call with our Administration Manager

Stage 3 — Test task

Stage 4 — Interview with the CEO and other members of the team



We review applications on a rolling basis. Should your qualifications align with our requirements, we will be in touch with the next steps.

title: Social-First Video Editor for Instagram (Hospitality Brands)
description:

We’re a fast-growing direct-to-consumer ecommerce company looking for a world-class AI Video Editor and Creative Generator who understands performance marketing, social media, and consumer psychology.



We’re looking for someone who can combine strong editing skills with the latest AI video-generation tools to create, test, and improve high-performing advertising concepts across Meta, TikTok & Instagram



You’ll use AI to generate realistic scenes, product demonstrations, UGC-style content, voiceovers, avatars, transitions, and visual variations—then turn those assets into scroll-stopping ads designed to drive sales.



What You’ll Do



AI Video Generation



* Generate realistic AI video scenes, product demonstrations, lifestyle footage, and UGC-style content

* Turn scripts, storyboards, images, and creative concepts into polished video advertisements

* Create AI actors, avatars, voiceovers, product visuals, backgrounds, and supporting B-roll

* Use AI tools to extend footage, replace backgrounds, improve visuals, and create new variations

* Produce content that feels natural, believable, and native to each social platform

* Stay up to date with emerging AI video, image, voice, and creative-generation tools



Performance Video Editing



* Edit short-form video ads for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Combine AI-generated footage with UGC, product footage, stock footage, and creator content

* Create multiple hooks, openings, angles, and variations from winning creatives

* Add captions, motion graphics, sound effects, music, transitions, and engaging visual elements

* Structure videos around strong hooks, clear problems, product benefits, proof, and calls to action

* Optimize every video for viewer retention, click-through rate, and conversions

* Review performance data and use creative learnings to improve future advertisements



## What We’re Looking For



* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Hands-on experience with AI video-generation and image-generation tools

* A strong understanding of pacing, hooks, storytelling, and viewer retention

* The ability to create realistic AI content that does not look obviously artificial

* A good eye for composition, lighting, product placement, and visual consistency

* The ability to follow creative briefs while also contributing original ideas

* Fast execution and the ability to produce multiple creative variations

* Strong attention to detail

* A genuine interest in performance marketing and direct-response advertising

* A willingness to test, learn, and improve based on creative performance



## Bonus Points



* Experience working with DTC ecommerce brands

* Experience editing direct-response advertisements

* Understanding of Meta Ads and TikTok Ads

* Experience creating realistic AI UGC content

* Experience sourcing stock footage and creator-style B-roll

* Experience with tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Veo, Seedance, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects



Compensation



* Full-time remote position

* You must be available to work full-time for eight hours per day

* Competitive salary based on experience

* Significant bonus incentives based on creative and advertising performance

* Long-term opportunity with clear room for growth

* Additional performance bonuses for exceptional work



We’re looking for an A-player who wants to become highly skilled in AI-powered creative production, test ideas rapidly, and become a key part of our growth team.



You won’t simply be editing videos.



You’ll be helping us build the next generation of performance advertising using AI.

sales. This role requires strong technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and a good understanding of e-commerce 

best practices, particularly within the jewelry industry.

listings, specifically in the context of jewelry products.

title: Full-Time Content, Community & Creator Growth VA
description:
**Skills / tags:** Video Editing · TikTok · Instagram Reels · YouTube Shorts · CapCut · Social Media Management · Reddit · Influencer Research · Community Management · Content Creation · AI Tools · Google Sheets



## Job description



We build consumer mobile apps and are looking for a reliable full-time VA to help us create short-form content, manage separate social accounts for each app, research creators, publish in relevant online communities, and support user engagement.



You will support three mobile apps:



- **StreakLeague:** a social habit and accountability app

- **Settle:** a group decision and voting app

- **Shotbox:** an app that turns screenshots into organised, actionable information



This is a combined content-production, social-account-management, community-growth, and creator-outreach role.



We will provide the product positioning, app access, screen recordings, approved brand assets, initial content angles, and guidance. You will turn these inputs into platform-native content, publish consistently, participate in relevant communities, respond to users, research creators, and track which activities generate qualified installs.



## Main responsibilities



### 1. Short-form video creation



- Turn written scripts, product ideas, app demonstrations, screenshots, and screen recordings into vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- Create videos approximately 15–45 seconds long

- Produce multiple opening hooks from one core idea

- Edit app recordings, screenshots, text overlays, licensed stock footage, approved visuals, music, and voiceovers

- Add captions, subtitles, clean cuts, sound effects, and platform-native formatting

- Create simple, natural-looking content rather than polished corporate advertisements

- Rework strong-performing videos into fresh variations

- Build and maintain reusable editing templates for each app

- Adapt videos for each platform instead of publishing the exact same version everywhere

- Export clean final files and keep project files organised in shared folders



You will not normally need to appear on camera. AI-assisted voiceovers, captions, b-roll, and visual tools may be used where appropriate. All AI-assisted content must follow the applicable platform rules.



### 2. Separate social account and channel management



Each app will have its own approved consumer-facing social accounts and channels. You will help set up, organise, and manage these accounts using company-controlled access.



This may include separate accounts for:



- TikTok

- Instagram

- YouTube Shorts

-
 Reels or
 Pages

- Reddit, where approved



Your responsibilities will include:



- Publish each piece of content to the correct app account

- Maintain the correct profile description, app-store link, branding, and pinned content

- Prepare platform-specific titles, captions, hashtags, calls to action, and descriptions

- Upload YouTube Shorts to the separate YouTube channel for each app

- Maintain a weekly content calendar for all three apps

- Track which concepts, hooks, formats, and platforms have already been tested

- Monitor comments and messages on active accounts

- Escalate bugs, payment questions, complaints, or sensitive issues

- Never change account ownership, recovery details, passwords, or permissions without approval

- Use company-provided manager or contributor access wherever available



The initial YouTube focus will be Shorts. Long-form YouTube production is not required unless later agreed.



### 3. Content scheduling and publishing



- Schedule and publish approved content across the relevant platforms

- Check every video, caption, link, app name, and call to action before publishing

- Adapt content to the style and technical requirements of each platform

- Avoid publishing identical captions and hashtags across every platform

- Repost or remake successful concepts without repeatedly uploading duplicate content

- Maintain an organised record of publication dates, links, captions, and content status

- Flag content that requires approval before publication

- Keep a balanced content mix across product demonstrations, relatable situations, challenges, outcomes, user questions, and feature education



### 4. Reddit posting, community participation, and app seeding



You will actively research and participate in relevant Reddit communities,
 Groups, 
 servers, and other approved online communities.



This is a core part of the role, not an occasional task.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Research relevant communities for each app

- Read and record each community’s rules before posting or commenting

- Identify whether promotional posts, app links, screenshots, cards, feedback requests, or comments are permitted

- Maintain a community tracker showing the community name, audience, rules, allowed content, previous activity, and results

- Draft and publish approved Reddit posts and comments

- Participate in relevant conversations with useful, natural responses

- Share app links only where relevant and permitted

- Avoid posting identical text across multiple communities

- Respond to every genuine comment on our active posts

- Monitor important Reddit posts during working hours for the first six hours after publication and respond promptly

- Record posts that are approved, removed, locked, or receive moderator feedback

- Collect product feedback, objections, feature requests, and recurring user questions

- Never ask for upvotes or artificial engagement



Community participation must be transparent, helpful, and compliant with platform rules. We do not use fake accounts, invented personal stories, copied comments, mass posting, vote manipulation, or misleading engagement.



### 5. StreakLeague community seeding and card distribution



For StreakLeague, you will:



- Research communities related to habits, fitness challenges, accountability, productivity, student routines, self-improvement, and gamification

- Identify discussions where people are looking for accountability partners, habit challenges, motivation, or streak-tracking tools

- Publish approved challenge stories and product demonstrations

- Share StreakLeague challenge cards where permitted

- Share progress cards, winner cards, commissioner roast cards, and elimination cards where permitted

- Add short, natural context explaining the challenge or result

- Invite genuinely interested users to try or join a habit league

- Follow up with the outcome of a challenge when appropriate

- Respond to questions about leagues, streaks, invitations, eliminations, and the commissioner experience

- Record which card types and community angles generate the most comments, clicks, and installs



### 6. Settle community seeding and card distribution



For Settle, you will:



- Research communities related to restaurants, food choices, couples, families, friend groups, student life, travel planning, group activities, and social decision-making

- Identify discussions where groups are struggling to choose between options

- Publish approved decision examples and voting scenarios

- Share Settle question cards, poll cards, voting cards, and final-result cards where permitted

- Invite commenters to vote when community rules allow

- Return to the discussion with the final result or winner card when appropriate

- Use relevant situations such as choosing a restaurant, activity, destination, purchase, or group plan

- Respond to questions about voting, invitations, deadlines, and final decisions

- Record which decision themes and card formats generate the most participation and installs



### 7. Shotbox community participation



For Shotbox, you will:



- Research communities related to productivity, screenshot organisation, digital clutter, mobile apps, personal knowledge management, shopping screenshots, receipts, and reminders

- Participate in relevant discussions where users are asking how to organise or recover useful screenshots

- Share approved product demonstrations and workflows where permitted

- Recruit suitable testers and collect structured feedback

- Respond to questions about screenshot scanning, organisation, search, privacy, and exports

- Avoid forcing the app into conversations where it is not relevant

- Record recurring user needs that could become future product or content ideas



### 8. Creator and influencer research



- Research relevant TikTok and Instagram creators for each app

- Prioritise creators in areas such as habits, fitness, productivity, student life, app discovery, food, Dubai lifestyle, organisation, and group activities

- Review follower count, recent views, median performance, engagement, audience location, content quality, and brand fit

- Identify creators whose audience matches the app, geography, and platform availability

- Distinguish between creators who are suitable for UGC production and creators who can provide valuable audience reach

- Review previous sponsored content and whether it appeared authentic

- Find public contact methods or approved marketplace profiles

- Maintain a qualified creator shortlist in a shared Google Sheet

- Flag suspicious engagement, weak recent performance, or poor audience fit

- Recommend the best creators for outreach based on evidence, not follower count alone



### 9. Personalised creator outreach and coordination



- Send approved outreach messages

- Personalise each message using the creator’s actual content

- Follow up politely when appropriate

- Avoid identical mass messages

- Coordinate initial questions from interested creators

- Share approved app access, briefs, scripts, campaign concepts, and deadlines

- Track quoted fees, deliverables, usage rights, publication dates, replies, and follow-ups

- Help coordinate creator posts after commercial terms are approved

- Request performance screenshots after creator posts where agreed

- Track promo codes, tagged links, or attributed installs where available

- Escalate negotiations, payments, contracts, and final commercial approvals to management



The VA will not approve payments, contracts, or commercial agreements independently.



### 10. Comment, message, and audience management



- Check comments and messages on active social accounts

- Respond to genuine questions using approved product information

- Thank users for useful feedback

- Maintain a friendly, professional, and human tone

- Respond quickly during the first hours after important posts

- Escalate bugs, complaints, payment questions, refund issues, and sensitive concerns

- Identify recurring objections, confusion, or feature requests

- Turn common questions and comments into future video ideas

- Record testimonials or positive feedback only when genuine and approved for reuse

- Never fabricate reviews, outcomes, or user stories



### 11. Performance tracking and reporting



Maintain a clean tracker containing:



- Videos produced

- App and platform

- Publication date

- Hook and concept used

- Caption and call to action

- Views

- Watch time or retention where available

- Likes, comments, shares, and saves

- Profile visits

- Link clicks

- Installs or attributed conversions where available

- Communities researched

- Community rules and permissions

- Reddit or group posts and comments

- Cards shared

- Post removals or moderator feedback

- Creator outreach status

- Creator replies

- Quoted fees

- Creator posts

- Promo codes or tracked links

- User feedback and feature requests



Provide:



- A short daily update

- A weekly performance summary

- The strongest-performing content

- The weakest-performing content

- The best-performing communities and card formats

- Creator outreach progress

- Common audience feedback

- Recommended concepts, communities, and creators to test next



## Typical eight-hour working day



The exact schedule may change depending on campaigns, but a normal working day will be approximately:



- **3.5 hours:** short-form video editing and content variations

- **1 hour:** scheduling, publishing, and management of separate app accounts

- **1.5 hours:** Reddit posting, community participation, card distribution, and comment replies

- **1.25 hours:** creator research, personalised outreach, and coordination

- **45 minutes:** analytics, tracker updates, file organisation, and daily reporting



**Total: 8 hours**



Time may be reallocated on days when an important post, creator campaign, app launch, or community discussion requires more attention.



## Expected weekly output



A normal week should include approximately:



### Short-form content



- **18 finished short-form videos**

- **9 videos for StreakLeague**

- **5 videos for Settle**

- **4 videos for Shotbox**

- Platform-specific versions, titles, captions, descriptions, and calls to action prepared

- TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts publishing completed for the approved accounts

- Reusable templates and project files kept organised



### Community and Reddit activity



- Research at least 10 relevant new communities

- Keep the community rules and permissions tracker updated

- Publish approximately 2–4 approved original community posts

- Share approximately 4–8 StreakLeague or Settle cards where permitted

- Make approximately 15–25 useful, relevant community comments

- Respond to genuine comments on all active app posts

- Monitor important Reddit posts during working hours for the first six hours after publication

- Record post removals, moderator messages, user feedback, link clicks, and resulting installs where available

- Provide one weekly summary of the strongest communities, card formats, and discussion angles



These are working targets, not permission to post where promotion is prohibited. Community quality and compliance take priority over volume.



### Creator outreach and operations



- Maintain an updated qualified creator shortlist

- Complete personalised outreach to approved creators

- Record replies, quoted rates, deliverables, usage rights, and next steps

- Follow up with interested creators

- Coordinate approved creator campaigns

- Track creator-post performance and attributed installs where available



### Reporting



- Complete daily tracker updates

- Submit a short daily progress update

- Submit one weekly performance and recommendations report



Output may vary based on video complexity, live campaigns, and community rules. Quality, relevance, consistency, and measurable learning are more important than rushed output.



## Requirements



- Proven short-form video editing experience

- Strong CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar editing skills

- Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, or YouTube Shorts

- Good written English

- Ability to write clear captions, simple hooks, and natural community comments

- Experience or strong interest in Reddit,
 Groups, 
, or online community management

- Comfortable researching creators and checking audience quality

- Comfortable using Google Sheets

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable internet connection

- Able to work independently from written briefs

- Organised and consistent with deadlines

- Comfortable learning and switching between three mobile apps

- Willing to test different creative approaches

- Able to distinguish genuine community participation from spam

- Able to follow platform and community rules exactly

- Available full-time for approximately 8 hours per weekday



Experience with the following is helpful but not required:



- Creator marketplaces

- Modash, HypeAuditor, or similar creator-research tools

- AI voiceover and captioning tools

- Canva

- Social-media scheduling platforms

- UGC editing

- Mobile-app marketing

- 
 or
 Group community management

- YouTube Shorts channel management

- Basic app analytics or attribution tracking



## Content, account, and community standards



All content and outreach must be truthful, original, and consistent with platform rules.



We do not:



- Fabricate customer reviews

- Claim results that did not happen

- Invent personal stories

- Impersonate users

- Use fake accounts

- Ask for upvotes or artificial engagement

- Manipulate votes or comments

- Mass-message communities or creators

- Post promotional links where they are prohibited

- Reuse copyrighted footage without permission

- Change company account ownership or recovery settings

- Publish unapproved commercial claims

- Agree to creator payments or contracts without approval



AI-assisted content must be labelled where required by the platform.



## How to apply



Start your application with the word **GROWTH** so we know you read the full post.



Please include:



1. Two or three short-form videos you personally edited

2. The editing and AI tools you use

3. Any experience with creator outreach, Reddit, or community management

4. One example of how you would find and evaluate relevant creators for a mobile app

5. One example of how you would introduce an app into a relevant online community without spamming

6. Your available working hours and time zone

7. Confirmation that you are available full-time

8. Your expected hourly rate



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical trial involving short-form editing, creator research, and community research.

title: Facebook / Meta Ads Media Buyer — Lead Gen & Direct Response
description:

Start your reply with the word "HOOK RATE" so I know you read this.

Answer this: "A lead-gen campaign was crushing it for 3 weeks, then CPL climbed 60% over 5 days with the same creative and budget. What's your read, and what do you do?"

Offer

description:

You will be the first point of contact for potential clients, pitching our web design, app development, and SEO services. Because you will be speaking directly with UK business owners and decision-makers, a neutral accent, exceptional English, and a confident phone manner are absolutely essential.



Key Responsibilities

• Outbound Prospecting: Identify and research potential B2B clients in the UK who could benefit from a new website, app, or improved SEO.

• Cold Calling &
ing: Execute high-volume outbound campaigns (cold calls,
s, and LinkedIn outreach) to introduce Dorset Tech's services.

• Lead Qualification: Ask the right questions to qualify prospects based on their budget, timeline, and technical needs.

• Appointment Setting: Book qualified discovery calls and consultations for our senior team to close (or, if you have the experience, close them yourself).

• CRM Management: Keep meticulous records of all calls,
s, and follow-ups in our CRM system.



Requirements

• B2B Sales Experience: Proven track record in outbound sales, cold calling, or appointment setting, preferably within the tech, SaaS, or digital agency space.

• Exceptional English: Flawless spoken and written English with a neutral or easily understood accent. You must be comfortable navigating conversations with UK business owners.

• Resilience: You must be comfortable with rejection and possess the drive to keep dialing and following up.

• Tech-Savvy: A basic understanding of web design (WordPress), SEO, and app development so you can speak credibly about our services.

• Availability: Must be available to work from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM UK time (which is 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM in the Philippines), Monday through Friday.



About Dorset Tech

We are Dorset's number one web design agency, and we are on a mission to disrupt the web design industry. We pride ourselves on offering the lowest rates in the country without compromising on quality, serving over 2,000 active support customers. We build everything from budget pay-monthly sites to full custom Laravel systems and Flutter mobile apps.



Beyond our technical expertise, we are a social enterprise and a carbon-negative company. We power our office with solar energy, drive electric cars, and plant a tree for every review we receive. If you want to sell a product you can genuinely believe in, for a company that cares about its community and the planet, Dorset Tech is the place for you.



Probation Period: Initial schedule will be 4–6 hours daily during probation, with transition to full-time expected within 2 months.



How to Apply

Please apply with your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your previous cold calling or B2B sales experience. Important: Please include a short audio or video recording introducing yourself and giving us a 30-second "mock pitch" of a web design service. Applications without a recording will not be considered.

description:

Volume is high, deadlines are tight, and creative direction shifts based on data. We need someone with a strong creative mind who delivers unique, brand-defining work — and isn't afraid of feedback or of putting in extra time to push a project across the finish line.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Amazon creatives: Listing Images, A+ Content (Basic and Premium), Brand Story, Brand Store, Amazon Posts, hero images, infographics, comparison charts

- Social media graphics: posts, stories, carousels across Instagram, TikTok,

 creative: Klaviyo campaign and flow graphics

- AI-embracing, not AI-skeptic: you've already integrated AI tools into your daily workflow to amplify (not replace) your craft. If you think AI is just hype, this isn't the role for you.
